ValidationRule.description: IM-86: Validation rule for the required fields(Team, Proposed Amount and Start / End Date) when "Include in Projection" is checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Initiative_Validation__c && AND( Include_in_Projections__c = TRUE, OR(ISBLANK(Team__c), ISBLANK(Proposed_Amount__c), ISBLANK( Start_Date__c), ISBLANK( End_Date__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete these fields to Include Initiative in Projection: Team, Proposed Amount and Start / End Date.
